zh.title: 美國航空 AA1494 因旅客滋擾改降鳳凰城，航機安全落地
zh.summary: 美國航空一班由聖地牙哥飛芝加哥的航班於 11 月 25 日凌晨改降鳳凰城。當地警方表示，機組與乘客制止了一名涉嫌干擾安全門的旅客。
body: 美國航空向 CBS 證實，原定由聖地牙哥飛往芝加哥的 AA1494 航班因旅客滋擾改降鳳凰城天港國際機場（PHX），於當地時間 11 月 25 日凌晨約 1 時安全落地。
鳳凰城警方表示，一名旅客涉嫌干擾航機的安全門，機組員和其他旅客在飛機降落前已將他制止。警方通報聯邦調查局（FBI），截至當天下午仍在調查。

en.title: American flight AA1494 diverts to Phoenix after passenger disturbance
en.summary: A San Diego–Chicago flight diverted to Phoenix and landed safely early on November 25. Police said the crew and passengers restrained a passenger suspected of tampering with an exit door.
body: American Airlines told CBS that its San Diego–Chicago flight AA1494 diverted to Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport because of a disruptive passenger. Phoenix police said the flight landed safely at around 1 a.m. local time on November 25.

Phoenix police said a passenger was suspected of tampering with an aircraft exit door. Crew members and passengers restrained him before landing. Police notified the FBI and said the incident remained under investigation that afternoon.

facts.claim: American Airlines confirmed that flight 1494 diverted to Phoenix Sky Harbor because of a passenger disturbance.
Phoenix police said the jet landed safely around 1 a.m. and the FBI was notified.
Phoenix police identified an aircraft exit door in its account and said the passenger was restrained before landing.
